name: @pi-outpost/mcp
description: A local MCP App: plannings kept in a folder the person picks, shown as pi-outpost's interactive timeline in Claude Desktop and other MCP Apps hosts.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && npm run build:viewer && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/bundle/server/index.mjs --log-level=warning "--banner:js=import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node ../apps-core/scripts/copy-guide.mjs dist/bundle/server
